identification: Winloop 0.8.1, a Cython/libuv asyncio event-loop implementation with Windows support
decisive_evidence: PyPI 0.8.1 sdist metadata digest equals the supplied archive digest.

Fetched original PyPI winloop 0.8.0 sdist (SHA-256 5a34605a72df5416279e89193688de0efb9e541c99e65923abcf0d7ff788510a). Its CI-unix.yml is byte-identical to 0.8.1, and the current scanner also reports one suspicious finding on 0.8.0. Thus the queue premise of a newly added firewall behavior does not hold for the immediately preceding release.

The same three-command macOS firewall step is present in fetched 0.7.0 (SHA-256 dcdea8aa687711e0a41cbe6280cb0957e2cb1f5dcbc51e65138503ea3a70ff7a); surrounding changes update the CI matrix, pin actions and add build jobs.

0.8.0 to 0.8.1 adds two WeakSet source files and changes 18 files. setup.py is unchanged. All libuv code and build scripts are unchanged; the sole libuv difference is autom4te.cache/requests key order with identical quoted-token populations.

New startupinfo handling is caller-controlled: None returns immediately; Windows-only validation permits STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW plus SW_HIDE, then sets UV_PROCESS_WINDOWS_HIDE_GUI. It flows through UVProcessTransport options to uv_spawn. Tests cover accepted and rejected flags.

WeakSet replaces weakref.WeakSet for async generator tracking; traced weak reference creation, iteration guards, pending removal callbacks and set operations. The generated C adds the corresponding WeakSet/RemovalSystem/IterationGuard machinery and startupinfo handler, with shifted generated labels. Native process/network API call populations are unchanged.

The firewall preference write belongs to the vendored libuv CI macOS job before configuring/building/running uv_run_tests. setup.py invokes autotools/configure/make or Cython/compiler sources; neither setup nor import invokes the workflow. The firewall write really does weaken a security control and remains suspicious independently of the package verdict.
unsupported_claims_corrected: com.apple.alf globalstate alone is a preference reference in both reads and writes, not evidence of a query. Preserve the exact matcher in preferences and add explicit socketfilterfw --getglobalstate and defaults read query atoms.
clone(...CLONE_VM) matched only libuv explanatory comments near a vfork capability probe; there is no PID grinding loop. Preserve the source-form matcher as metadata.
getuid returning zero is a Windows compatibility definition guarded by _WIN32, not preload hijacking on its own. Preserve the matcher as function metadata and keep preload/build objective consumers.
KERN_PROC_PID selects a process for ordinary BSD executable-path and process-info queries, with no hiding action. Preserve the reference as a neutral process query selector.

STARTF_USESTDHANDLES plus the three stdio field names establishes explicit stdio fields, not a socket or shared handle. libuv test runner assigns NUL/file handles. Rename the composite and preserve all conditions, proximity, scope and severity.
scope_notes: All five relocated or renamed matchers retain their previous patterns and criticalities. The metadata clone source-form rule drops an illegal metadata-to-micro-behavior exclusion for kernel-source-context; matching kernel comment/source forms may now surface as neutral metadata. Existing metadata and identity exclusions remain.

Ancestor reference audit found objectives/discovery consumed by two OOB exception rules and credential-export-with-recon-or-ranking. A bare firewall preference reference must not supply reconnaissance there. The new preference reference is neutral; no objective is silently restored to preserve a false reconnaissance claim.
The new preference observation enters broad micro-behaviors/fs selectors. Full archive rescan shows only the seven expected new IDs, and no additional derived objectives.
The bind-shell consumer retains its prior evidence set with the renamed stdio observation; no listener or execution condition was weakened.
remaining_disagreement: None between the local classifier and BENIGN judgment. One accurate suspicious firewall operation remains. The queue listed 701 notable traits; the reproducible local no-follow baseline has 696, increasing to 698 after these changes. No suspicious or hostile finding was removed.
